registryBasis: The official Santa Cruz de Tenerife municipal sede identifies a Punto de Información Catastral (PIC) operated by the Ayuntamiento and offers consultation of non-protected cadastral data and digital cartography. The national Dirección General del Catastro is the cadastral custodian and publishes the municipality parcel download.
technicalBlocker: The municipality ATOM download is a complete first-party bulk dataset, but this packet does not independently qualify a runtime adapter. Bounded anonymous WFS GetCapabilities probes to the published INSPIRE WFS URL returned HTTP 400; no credentials, CAPTCHA, private token, or protected fields were requested.
